name: Zure, Knight of Dark World
desc: The name of this illustrious knight is known by all residents of Dark World. He never oppresses the commoners.

name: V-Tiger Jet
desc: This ace fighter is unbeatable in a dogfight. It combines with other monsters to launch an array of encircling attacks.

name: Blade Skater
desc: An image of beauty on the ice, this gorgeous warrior rips her opponents into pieces with her stylish Accel Slicer attack.

name: Queen's Knight
desc: This knight catches her opponents off guard, dominating them with swift yet graceful attacks.

name: Jack's Knight
desc: A strong master swordsman. His loyalty is to justice, his duty to protect the weak.

name: King's Knight
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned while you control "Queen's Knight": You can Special Summon 1 "Jack's Knight" from your Deck.

name: Elemental HERO Bladedge
desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

name: Elemental HERO Wildheart
desc: Unaffected by Trap effects.

name: Reborn Zombie
desc: While you have no cards in your hand and this card is in Attack Position, it cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Chthonian Soldier
desc: When this card is destroyed by an opponent's attacking monster and sent to the Graveyard, the Battle Damage you took from this battle is also inflicted to your opponent.

name: W-Wing Catapult
desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 "V-Tiger Jet" you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead. The equipped monster gains 400 ATK/DEF.

name: Infernal Incinerator
desc: This card can only be Normal Summoned or Set by discarding all other card(s) in your hand and Tributing 1 card you control with 2000 or more ATK. This card gains 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. This card loses 500 ATK for each other monster you control.

name: Hydrogeddon
desc: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 "Hydrogeddon" from your Deck.

name: Oxygeddon
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle with a Pyro monster and sent to the GY: Each player takes 800 damage.

name: Water Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned with "Bonding - H2O". The ATK of FIRE monsters and Pyro monsters on the field becomes 0. When this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can target 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon" in your GY; Special Summon them.

name: Etoile Cyber
desc: If this card attacks directly, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only.

name: B.E.S. Tetran
desc: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

name: Nanobreaker
desc: If this card attacks a face-up Level 3 or lower monster, destroy the monster immediately with this card's effect without applying damage calculation.

name: Rapid-Fire Magician
desc: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent each time you activate a Normal Spell Card.

name: Beiige, Vanguard of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Special Summon this card.

name: Broww, Huntsman of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Draw 1 card, or, if it was discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect, draw 2 cards instead.

name: Brron, Mad King of Dark World
original_name: Brron, Mad King of Dark World
desc: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can discard 1 card.

name: Sillva, Warlord of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: Special Summon this card, then, if it was discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect, your opponent places exactly 2 cards from their hand on the bottom of their Deck, in any order.

name: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
desc: If this card is discarded to the GY by card effect: If it was discarded from your hand to your GY by an opponent's card effect, you can target up to 2 cards your opponent controls; Special Summon this card, then destroy those targets (if any).

name: Scarr, Scout of Dark World
desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Add 1 Level 4 or lower "Dark World" monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Aussa
desc:
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Aussa the Earth Charmer" and 1 face-up EARTH monster from your Monster Zone to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Eria
desc:
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Eria the Water Charmer" and 1 face-up WATER monster from your Monster Zone to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Hiita
desc:
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Hiita the Fire Charmer" and 1 face-up FIRE monster from your Monster Zone to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Familiar-Possessed - Wynn
desc:
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand or Deck) by sending 1 face-up "Wynn the Wind Charmer" and 1 face-up WIND monster from your Monster Zone to the GY. If this card Special Summoned by its own effect attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: VW-Tiger Catapult
desc:
"V-Tiger Jet" + "W-Wing Catapult"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. You can discard 1 card, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position. (Flip effects are not activated.)

name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
desc:
"VW-Tiger Catapult" + "XYZ-Dragon Cannon"
Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by banishing the above cards you control. Once per turn: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish that target. When this card declares an attack on an opponent's monster: You can target the attack target; change that attack target's battle position. (Flip effects are not activated.)

name: Cyber Blader
desc:
"Etoile Cyber" + "Blade Skater"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. This card gains the following effect, based on the number of monsters your opponent controls.
● 1: Cannot be destroyed by battle.
● 2: This card's ATK is doubled.
● 3: Your opponent's activated card effects are negated.

name: Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster
desc:
"Elemental HERO Clayman" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned. This card can attack directly while in Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation, and its ATK is halved during damage calculation only.

name: Elemental HERO Tempest
desc:
"Elemental HERO Avian" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman" + "Elemental HERO Bubbleman"
Must be Fusion Summoned. You can send 1 other card you control to the GY, then target 1 monster you control; while this card is face-up on the field, that monster cannot be destroyed by battle.

name: Elemental HERO Wildedge
desc:
"Elemental HERO Wildheart" + "Elemental HERO Bladedge"
Must be Fusion Summoned and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card can attack every monster your opponent controls (one attack on each monster per Battle Phase).

name: Elemental HERO Shining Flare Wingman
desc:
"Elemental HERO Flame Wingman" + "Elemental HERO Sparkman"
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 300 ATK for each "Elemental HERO" card in your GY. If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK in the GY.

name: Pot of Avarice
desc: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Dark World Lightning
desc: Target 1 Set card on the field; destroy that target, then discard 1 card.

name: Level Modulation
desc: Your opponent draws 2 cards. Special Summon 1 "LV" monster from your Graveyard, ignoring the Summoning conditions. The monster that was Special Summoned by this effect cannot attack, nor activate or apply its effect this turn.

name: Ojamagic
desc: If this card is sent from the hand or field to the GY: Add 1 each of "Ojama Green", "Ojama Yellow", and "Ojama Black" from your Deck to your hand.

name: Ojamuscle
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Ojama" card.)
Select 1 face-up "Ojama King". Destroy all "Ojama" monsters on the field, except the selected "Ojama King". It gains 1000 ATK for each monster destroyed this way.

name: Feather Shot
desc: Target 1 face-up "Elemental HERO Avian" you control; during this turn, that target can attack a number of times equal to the number of monsters you control when this card resolves, but cannot attack directly, and other monsters you control cannot attack this turn.

name: Bonding - H2O
desc: Tribute 2 "Hydrogeddon" and 1 "Oxygeddon"; Special Summon 1 "Water Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

name: Chthonian Alliance
desc: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK for each other face-up monster on the field that has the same name it does.

name: Armed Changer
desc: Send 1 Equip Spell Card from your hand to the Graveyard to activate this card. If the equipped monster destroys a monster by battle, the controller of this Equip Card can add 1 monster with ATK equal to or less than the equipped monster from their Graveyard to their hand.

name: Branch!
desc: When a Fusion Monster(s) on the field is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of the Fusion Materials in your Graveyard that was used for its Fusion Summon; Special Summon it.

name: Boss Rush
desc:
You cannot activate this card if you Normal Summoned/Set this turn. While this card is face-up on the field, you cannot Normal Summon/Set. During the End Phase, if a face-up "B.E.S." monster you control was destroyed and sent to the GY this turn: You can Special Summon 1 "B.E.S." monster from your Deck.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Gateway to Dark World
desc: Target 1 "Dark World" monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. You cannot Summon monsters the turn you activate this card, except by this effect (but you can Normal Set).

name: Hero Barrier
desc:
During your opponent's turn: negate the next attack this turn from a monster your opponent controls while you control an "Elemental HERO" monster.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

name: Chthonian Blast
desc: When a face-up monster you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Destroy the 1 face-up monster on the field that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied), and if you do, inflict damage to both players equal to half of that monster's ATK.

name: The Forces of Darkness
desc: Target 2 "Dark World" monsters in your GY; add those targets to your hand.

name: Dark Deal
desc: When your opponent activates a Normal Spell Card: Pay 1000 LP; the activated effect of that Normal Spell becomes "Your opponent discards 1 random card".

name: Simultaneous Loss
desc: Each player sends the top card of their Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Weed Out
desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Destroy all face-up Attack Position Level 3 monsters.

name: The League of Uniform Nomenclature
desc: Select 1 face-up Level 2 or lower Normal Monster you control to activate this card. Special Summon as many cards as possible from your Deck with the same name as the selected monster.

name: Roll Out!
desc: Target 1 Union monster in your GY; equip that target to an appropriate monster you control for that Union monster's effect.

name: Chthonian Polymer
desc: Activate only when your opponent Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster. Tribute 1 monster to take control of that Fusion Monster.

name: Feather Wind
desc: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated while you control a face-up "Elemental HERO Avian": Negate the activation and destroy it.

name: Non-Fusion Area
desc: Neither player can Fusion Summon.

name: Level Limit - Area A
desc: Change all face-up Level 3 or lower monsters to Attack Position.
